records.reason: Checking costs nothing and preserves the chance to win; folding gives it up.
Hero holds the exclusive royal flush on the river and cannot lose. Never fold.
Even an all-in cannot justify folding the exclusive river nuts.
The board is a royal flush: calling guarantees a split and recovers the existing investment (no rake).
Four aces cannot lose on this unconnected river board.
The rainbow broadway board guarantees a split; no flush is possible.
Call the guaranteed split; raising cannot win more chips on a royal board.
Hero plays four twos with the board's three kicker: every possible opponent holding wins or ties, so an enormous call is unjustified.
Early-position suited broadway in an unopened six-seat pot.
